description:
Browse the public ordinals P2P trade ledger at ledger.drx4.xyz.

Returns a paginated list of trades with optional filters. Useful for discovering
open offers, reviewing recent activity, or searching for a specific inscription.

No wallet required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

inscription_id.description: Filter by inscription ID (txid + 'i' + index, e.g. abc123i0)

name: ordinals_p2p_list_trades
